name: WWC Universal Champion
epitaph: The top belt of a fed that never crowned anyone. WWC's own Titles & Champions page — the whole of what survives of it — bills the Universal Championship VACANT from the site's earliest surviving capture (2 August 2001) to its last (29 August 2009); the roster it would have been defended on never filled with a single wrestler across that span (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html; promotions/wwc-council/archive/roster.html).

name: WWC North American Champion
epitaph: Second on WWC's own title ledger and, like every belt on it, never awarded. The North American Championship is billed VACANT in the fed's only surviving Titles & Champions capture, unchanged across the whole eight-year Wayback record held for this site — no wrestler ever registered to contest it (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html).

name: WWC European Champion
epitaph: A belt on a card that never ran. The European Championship is billed VACANT on WWC's own Titles & Champions page, the fed's whole surviving title ledger, alongside all seven other championships — the site's roster page names no wrestler at any point in the capture to have won it (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html).

name: WWC Hardcore Champion
epitaph: The Hardcore Championship is one more line on WWC's own title ledger, billed VACANT alongside every other belt the fed named for itself — the surviving capture shows no card, no result, and no roster entry that could ever have put a name against it (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html).

name: WWC Television Champion
epitaph: Billed VACANT on WWC's own Titles & Champions page like every other belt the fed listed. The Television Championship never had a card to be defended on: the site's own Cards page names three show slots and fills none of them (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html; promotions/wwc-council/archive/cards.html).

name: WWC Cruiserweight Champion
epitaph: The Cruiserweight Championship sits VACANT on WWC's own title ledger with the rest of the fed's eight belts, in a promotion whose roster page reads "NONE AS OF YET" in every capture on file — no cruiserweight, or wrestler of any weight class, was ever signed to contest it (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html; promotions/wwc-council/archive/roster.html).

name: WWC Tag Team Champions
epitaph: WWC's Tag Team Championship is billed VACANT the same as its six singles belts and its Stable Title. The roster page's own "Tag Teams" section lists none — the fed's whole surviving record shows no team ever formed to be crowned (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html; promotions/wwc-council/archive/roster.html).

name: WWC Stable Title
epitaph: The last of WWC's eight named championships, billed VACANT with the rest. The roster page's own "Stables" section lists none, and no stable appears anywhere else in the eight documents this promotion survives on (promotions/wwc-council/archive/titles-and-champions.html; promotions/wwc-council/archive/roster.html).
